csv_project_name: DB for Cleveland Sports Events & Aquatics Center
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cleveland (Owner) in conjunction with Sports Facilities Company (SFC) (Owner s Representative) invites qualified Design-Build companies (Design-Build Teams) to submit Design-Build Proposals including statements of qualifications (SOQs) to provide integrated design and construction services for the Cleveland Sports, Events, and Aquatics Center (the Project). The City is seeking a uniquely qualified Design-Build Team with experience working with municipalities and other governmental entities that will provide design, preconstruction, construction, and related services as necessary to make the proposed Cleveland Sports, Events, and Aquatics Center a City of Cleveland gold-standard destination multi-sports venue
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering, Stormwater

title: Design-Build for Cleveland Sports Events & Aquatics Center
short_description: Design-build procurement for a new multi-sports and aquatics center in Cleveland, Tennessee.
project_scope: New Cleveland Sports, Events, and Aquatics Center planned as a gold-standard destination multi-sports venue for the City of Cleveland. The notice indicates an integrated design-build delivery including sports, events, and aquatics functions, but provides no gross floor area, seating capacity, pool dimensions, span data, or other technical characteristics.
services: Integrated design-build services including design, preconstruction, construction, and related services. Requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, utility engineering, and stormwater.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports and aquatics center is within sbp's target area for sports facilities.
- Early design-build stage offers strategic entry through collaboration with the design-build team.
- Potential for long-span roof structures over sports halls or pool areas, which could suit sbp.
- However, the notice provides no concrete structural data, spans, architectural ambition, or special structural challenges.
- Tender is broad design-build procurement rather than a focused structural engineering package.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice.
